shared.cold_scope: Fresh worker process and model owner; OS page cache is uncontrolled and file hashing may warm it. No storage-cold or idle-host claim.
shared.service_actions: Existing services remain running; do not pause containers or change system caches.

interpretation.source_preparation: Original BF16 and prepared F32 storage inventories are recorded separately; BF16-to-F32 export transient memory is outside these preserved-package load/compile runs.
interpretation.timings: Completed public calls including serialization and the requested I32 output; wall time is not kernel time.
interpretation.rss_samples: Interval samples are lower bounds on interval peak. VmHWM is the exact Linux process-lifetime high-water report and includes SDK imports and setup.
interpretation.engine_memory: Respect MemoryInventoryKind, truncation and ownership; allocator counters describe tracked requested capacity, not physical RSS or VRAM.
interpretation.gpu_memory: Memory-only CUDA workers sample NVML compute-process/device memory every10ms, with startup/end device free samples. Driver process residency includes contexts/driver costs; device-wide telemetry overlaps other processes. Interval samples are lower bounds, not exact request peaks or graph allocation counters.
interpretation.storage: Snapshot logical size and filesystem blocks are separate from RSS, weight capacities and device memory. Do not add overlapping quantities.
interpretation.trace: Separate segmented instrumented run; preserve raw event/snapshot sidecars, per-segment loss and seeded allocator coverage. Copy and synchronization observations are not uninstrumented latency. Never sum segment/allocator peaks; retirement-only missing allocators remain unobserved.
interpretation.qualification: Finite, route-attested observations and cleanup can pass. Exact whole-system peak, nonregression and speed improvements remain unqualified without a matching baseline and prospective allowance.

shared.trace_collection_scope: Eight sequential NODES collectors: load/compile plus first cycle, each of six cases, and final owner retirement. Each collector has64MiB, zero loss and complete accounting for reported allocator rows. Raw event/snapshot streams are retained in gzip sidecars. Visited execution owners seed per-segment requested capacity; peaks remain per-segment and per-allocator. Retirement-only allocator coverage is unvisited/unknown, independently described by public inventory snapshots.

cached_execute.purpose: Current-artifact observational baseline; no performance or whole-memory regression verdict
cached_execute.warm_scope: Warmed model/compiled owner and process; each cycle creates a fresh execution context. Context creation and retirement are measured separately from public execution calls.

full_prefix_generate.purpose: Current trained-checkpoint full-prefix GREEDY/RANDOM Generate observational baseline; same4ID controls as E HF correctness, no regression verdict
full_prefix_generate.warm_scope: Warmed model/compiled owner and process; each cycle creates a fresh generation context with a fresh RNG seed. Context creation and retirement are measured separately from Generate calls.
